testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.publish.ReleaseCasTests

testcase.name: a rollback that loses the scope before its pointer write changes no status and no pointer()
a release that is ROLLING_BACK is never served()
publish A holds the scope and is slow, its lease expires, B takes over and publishes, A finishes late - A's pointer write is refused and B stays active()
the first release failing after the switch - ROLLING_BACK, the pointer is NULL, never the failed release()
the previous release cannot be restored - fail closed - pointer NULL, ROLLBACK_FAILED then ROLLBACK_OFFLINE()
a release that is unhealthy after the switch is ROLLING_BACK first, then the previous release is back - by compare-and-set()
a roll-forward leaves the release it moved away from RUNNING()
the same operation takes over - the earlier run of it goes silent while the resumed run decides()
a release operation that is alive blocks the lifecycle for a bounded time - 409 SCOPE_BUSY, nothing changes, the operation is not disturbed()
no production code writes the active pointer outside the scope guard()
archiving or deleting an application takes the site offline through the scope - a publish that was mid-flight is fenced out and an older one is stale()
the static provider never moves the pointer without a fence()
an application that never had a site has nothing to take offline()
two requests of one rollback converge - the second finds it done and reports AlreadyActive()
rolling back to an older release marks the newer one ROLLED_BACK in the same transaction as the pointer()
a manual rollback that fails leaves every status and the pointer as they were()
